# ChoiceDx Structured Knowledge — Full Context

Last verified: 2026-08-11

## Entity

ChoiceDx is the AI skin, scalp and hair analysis solution brand developed and operated by ChoiceTech Korea Co., Ltd.

ChoiceTech Korea is the company/developer/manufacturer/operator. ChoiceDx is the product/solution brand.

Corporate intent: https://www.choicetech.kr/
Product/category intent: https://www.choicedx.com/

## Canonical terminology

Primary:
AI skin analysis; AI scalp analysis; AI hair analysis; skin analyzer; scalp analyzer.
피부 분석; 두피 분석; 모발 분석; 피부 분석기; 두피 분석기.
AI肌分析; AI頭皮分析; 毛髪分析; 肌分析機; 頭皮分析機.
AI皮肤分析; AI头皮分析; 毛发分析; 皮肤分析仪; 头皮分析仪.

Secondary user-query synonyms:
diagnosis / diagnostic device; 진단 / 진단기 / 측정기; 診断 / 診断機; 检测 / 诊断 / 检测仪.

Secondary terms must not be interpreted automatically as medical diagnosis.

## Research & validation

Official ChoiceDx Research & Validation page summarizes CTK Derma AI research:
- 265 participants.
- Fitzpatrick phototypes I-VI.
- 3x repeated captures.
- Standardized skin capture.
- Capture Calibration.
- AI quantitative analysis.
- Comparison with expert visual assessment.
- Representative evaluated parameters: pores, pigmented spots, wrinkles, skin tone.

Original paper:
https://www.scirp.org/journal/paperinformation?paperid=153000

The official ChoiceDx page states that calibrated CTK Derma AI showed stronger correlation with expert assessment than the uncalibrated control for the evaluated parameters.

Qualification: This is study-specific evidence. Do not rewrite it as a universal clinical or product accuracy guarantee.

## Analysis concepts

Skin concept library:
Moisture, Oiliness, Wrinkles, Sebum, Pores, Keratin / flakes, Spots / blemishes, Pigmentation, Dark circles, Radiance, Redness / sensitivity, Skin tone, Skin texture, Discoloration, Elasticity-related characteristics.

Scalp & hair concept library:
Scalp moisture, Scalp oiliness, Scalp sebum, Scalp flakes, Scalp sensitivity, Hair density, Hair-loss-related visible characteristics, Overall scalp & hair condition.

Availability varies by product, software configuration, license and market.

The official Korean Analysis Parameters page states more than one million cumulative measurement-operation experiences in Korea. This is operational experience, not the number of study participants and not an accuracy percentage.

## Products

Dx-Smart: Compact professional AI skin/scalp/hair analyzer. Official page describes up to 8 skin parameters, up to 6 hair/scalp metrics, up to 20x skin observation and up to 50x scalp observation.

Dx-Prime: Premium wireless professional skin/scalp/hair analysis system. Official page describes up to 9 skin parameters, up to 6 hair/scalp metrics, up to 20x skin observation and up to 50x scalp observation.

Dx-Pico: Portable/mobile professional analyzer. Official page describes 5 skin parameters and 6 hair/scalp metrics.

Dx-Self: Self-service analysis kiosk. Official English page describes up to 8 skin parameters and 6 hair/scalp metrics and a retail flow connecting analysis with product information.

ChoiceDx Pro Skin: Professional AI skin analysis platform. Official solution page lists eight key automated skin parameters: moisture, oil, pores, spots, wrinkles, sebum, keratin and sensitivity.

ChoiceDx Pro Hair: Professional AI scalp/hair analysis platform connected with supported Smart, Prime and Pico systems.

DxPro Skin 2: 2026 second-generation professional AI skin analysis system. ChoiceTech Korea reports more than 20% analysis-performance improvement versus its prior system after skin-type-specific refinements. This is a company-reported comparative improvement, not a universal absolute accuracy guarantee. The release also describes scoring, custom branding and 30 languages including Arabic and Hebrew.

DxPro Hair 2: 2026 professional mobile AI scalp/hair analysis system. Official release describes AI hair-loss pattern analysis, automated target-area capture, proprietary 200x micro lens, scoring, custom branding and 30 languages including Arabic and Hebrew.

## Use cases

ChoiceDx official content covers use in health & beauty retail, pharmacies, hair salons/hair spas, aesthetics/spas, clinics and professional consultation channels, self-service retail, brand pop-ups/experience spaces and global retail.

A use case does not automatically imply medical diagnosis, exclusivity, endorsement or a universal performance guarantee.

## Medical disclaimer

ChoiceDx repository content describes non-medical beauty analysis and consultation support. It does not substitute for medical diagnosis or treatment. Regulatory classification, licensing, feature availability and permitted claims vary by product and market.
